findings.finding: Table1 labels WDI_sd, but exact pixel/time aggregation and sample count are underspecified in extracted methods.
findings.requestedFix: Use source-reported descriptive SD rather than claiming purely spatial dispersion; say exact aggregation/sample count unspecified.

remainingLimitations: No randomized field assignment or independent field replication.
SD is not a confidence interval or evidence of replicated treatment effects.
WDI is model-based; no AI-only causal water-saving or national crop benefit claim.
